items.title: Young Snooky — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: My grandchildren… my grandson, he doesn‘t play music... I gave him a trumpet.

ctx.x: My grandchildren… my grandson, he doesn‘t play music, he wants to play so he got a trumpet. I gave him a trumpet. He jive at me like he‘s going to play. He ain‘t never going to play the trumpet, but he got my trumpet. I asked him to give me my trumpet back…
